sources.entry: DeepSeek - A powerful AI platform offering open-source LLMs such as DeepSeek-V3 (671B) and DeepSeek R1 (660B), along with smaller models (1.5B, 7B, 14B) for local deployment. It also features a paid API compatible with OpenAI's format, supporting streaming and enterprise solutions.

summary.name: DeepSeek
summary.one_liner: DeepSeek (深度求索) is an AI company's site offering a chat app, web interface, API platform, and open-source large language models.
use_cases: build apps using the DeepSeek API
project development with a lower-cost model
add web search to an AI application
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page for DeepSeek, which describes itself as researching general-purpose AI foundation models and technology. It links to a web chat interface with DeepThink and Search modes, a desktop app called Harness Desktop, an API Platform with API docs, and a downloads section. It announces that DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was updated to version V4.1-Flash-1017, with better project development capabilities, and that the API now supports web search and fetch. The meta description names open-source releases including DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek-R1.
notable: Open-source model releases such as DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek-R1
API now supports web search and fetch
DeepThink and Search modes in the chat interface
Harness Desktop app and API Platform
caveats: Pricing for the API is not stated on this page
Listing describes the API as paid, but the page itself does not state pricing
